title: Dell USB 3.0 Ultra HD/4K Triple Display Docking Station (D3100), Black
writeup: The Dell D3100 is a DisplayLink dock that puts three monitors, Gigabit Ethernet and five USB ports on one USB 3.0 cable. Dell's user guide lists one 4K screen at 30Hz on DisplayPort plus two HDMI screens at 2048x1152 and 60Hz when all three are used. It does not charge your laptop, and it connects over USB-A, so a USB-C laptop needs an adapter. Dell's guide and Laptop Mag's review are the sources. We have not tested it.
